title: Mapping the structural brain network of psychopathy: Convergent evidence from humans and chimpanzees
title_zh: 心理变态脑结构网络的映射：人类与黑猩猩的共识证据
abstract: Psychopathy, a condition marked by profound emotional and interpersonal deficits, has long been hypothesized to arise, in part, from structural abnormalities in the brain. Yet neuroimaging studies have reported widely disparate findings, preventing definitive conclusions. Here, we sought to resolve these discrepancies by testing whether heterogeneous peak locations identified across studies converge on a common brain network. We conducted a systematic literature search of PubMed, Web of Science, EMBASE, and Scopus, identifying 18 studies (20 independent samples) examining whole-brain grey matter volume in psychopathy. Using neuroanatomical data from 1000 healthy participants, we found that grey matter volume at these peak locations varied together, forming a shared network that primarily encompassed paralimbic regions, including the cingulate and insular cortices. We next examined whether psychopathic and personality traits predicted inter-individual variation in grey matter volume within this network in humans (n = 107) and chimpanzees (n = 148). Significant effects were observed in both species, explaining 15-16% and 42-48% of the variance, respectively. Taken together, these findings indicate that psychopathy is best characterized by structural deficits in a distributed neural system rather than isolated regions, providing a unifying account of decades of inconsistent findings and advancing our understanding of its clinical, biological, and evolutionary bases.
abstract_zh: 心理变态是一种以深刻情感和人际关系缺陷为特征的状况，长期以来有人假设其部分源于大脑结构异常。然而，神经影像学研究报告的结果差异很大，阻碍了明确结论的得出。本研究旨在通过检验不同研究中识别的峰值位置是否聚焦于共同的大脑网络来解决这些矛盾。我们对 PubMed、Web of Science、EMBASE 和 Scopus 进行了系统文献检索，识别出 18 项研究（20 个独立样本）探讨心理变态的全脑灰质体积。利用 1000 名健康参与者的神经解剖数据，我们发现这些峰值位置的灰质体积呈同步变化，形成了一个共享网络，主要包含旁边缘区，包括扣带皮层和岛叶皮层。随后，我们检验了心理变态和人格特质是否能预测该网络内灰质体积的个体差异，分别在人体（n = 107）和黑猩猩（n = 148）中进行。两种物种均观察到显著效应，分别解释了 15-16% 和 42-48% 的方差。综上所述，这些发现表明，心理变态最好被描述为分布式神经系统的结构缺陷，而非孤立区域，为数十年来不一致的研究结果提供了统一解释，并推进了对其临床、生物学和进化基础的理解。
